done_when: scripts/dev/test_successor_wake.py has a chain test (test_chain_second_registration_survives_first_run_finally) that fails on commit 2add4f3cd and passes after the fix: with MTS_SUCC_WAKE_TASK=MTS-SuccWake-B set, the generated script for the next link (a) does not call Start-ScheduledTask on the running name, (b) uses a trigger or a distinct generation so it fires after the first run exits, and (c) the first run.ps1 finally unregisters only its own generation (a token check), never the new one; the existing 4b3 rules still hold (one one-shot, no repeat, self-unregistering). git cherry origin/fast-track <content sha> empty and git ls-tree -r origin/fast-track --name-only shows scripts/dev/successor_wake.py and scripts/dev/test_successor_wake.py.
goal: Make the MTS-SuccWake chain survive its first link: when a Supervisor started by task MTS-SuccWake-<L> calls successor_wake.register for the next wake (env MTS_SUCC_WAKE_TASK set), the new task must still exist and must fire after the old run ends. Cause (register B14, Opus note of 2026-10-28): the new registration reuses the same task name, Start-ScheduledTask on a Running task is ignored by Windows, and the old run.ps1 finally unregisters the name, deleting the new task.
note: DRAFT 2026-10-28 Session_Planner (planner-refine-2, OURS): fix design is a default, the worker may take the fallback if Parallel instances fail. Gate: not live path; no real task registered in tests; fail-first quote required. SCHEDULING_POLICY.md edit counts against its SIZE_CAP.

steps: Read successor_wake.py build_script (run.ps1 try/finally, Start-ScheduledTask branch), register (SELF_ENV bypass of the B10 guard, lines near LIVE_STATES) and test_successor_wake.py B10 tests

Fix (OURS default): register with a per-generation token in the task Description and a settings object MultipleInstances Parallel; when SELF_ENV is set use a -Once trigger at now+1 minute instead of Start-ScheduledTask; run.ps1 finally unregisters only when the task Description still equals its own token. Fallback if Parallel does not work on this Windows build: unique name MTS-SuccWake-<L>-<utc stamp> (then widen the B10 live-state probe and device_tasks ALLOWED_TASKS prefix check, which already allows the MTS-SuccWake- prefix)
